current.reasoning: The candidate changes only the Console Memo detail/preview boundary, request-scoped initial projection, unauthorized read status mapping, shared route history state, and the complete official build-time Web Demo evidence surface. Public API payload shapes, durable application state, snapshot publishing, and deployment host configuration remain unchanged; unauthorized private reads remain indistinguishable from missing resources, while the Demo uses explicit guest projections that omit authoring-only fields. Console Web Demo mutations use tab-scoped sessionStorage for the full in-browser edit state and a short-lived same-origin cookie containing only deletion and visibility metadata for SSR boundary continuity; the cookie never carries authored Memo bodies and cannot promote private or draft seed records in guest SSR.

persistent_state.state_description: No SQLite schema, local-content format, or durable release-ledger state changes. The Web Demo uses tab-scoped sessionStorage for full client-side edit state plus a short-lived same-origin cookie containing only deletion and visibility metadata for Console SSR and dedicated-preview boundaries; it is not application persistence and never transports authored Memo bodies in the cookie.
